verdict.rationale: An OS with a built-in AI assistant (Siri AI, which takes actions in apps) could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. Siri's app actions and Shortcuts automation are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
